entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: The enchantment-wielding captain of the Scourge, later Admiral of the Fathom Fleet and Governor of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate coalition on Ixalan formed after the collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes, later made a nation by Brass.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Brass and the Brazen Coalition live.

entities.name: Scourge
entities.description: Brass's ship, fabled for its magically imbued brass figurehead.

entities.name: Ripper
entities.description: Brass's cutlass.

entities.name: Jareth Wake
entities.description: The navigator of Squid Eyes who builds enchanted instruments to find Brass.

entities.name: Squid Eyes
entities.description: The ship whose collision with the Scourge created High and Dry.

entities.name: Lex Briggs
entities.description: Brass's trusted navigator and first mate who magically augments and undermines navigational equipment.

entities.name: Swab
entities.description: The Scourge's goblin prankster whose trickery disrupts Lex's charms.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: The floating city created by the collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes, retaken by Brass during the invasion.

entities.name: Fathom Fleet
entities.description: Brass's disciplined, fearsome collection of ships.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that destroyed Brass's fleet and original dream of the Coalition.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The artifact whose branches arced over the ocean sky at the start of the invasion.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: A Sun Empire faction representative at a meeting Brass crashes.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A representative of a Sun Empire faction at the meeting Brass crashes.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: A Legion of Dusk representative at the meeting Brass crashes.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The Ixalani empire whose faction meets with Brass.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire faction of Torrezon whose representative meets with Brass.

entities.name: Tunnel-Grinder
entities.description: A machine built by Brass to dig below the surface to Tecutlan.

entities.name: Tecutlan
entities.description: A location Brass reaches with her Tunnel-Grinder.

entities.name: The Indomitable
entities.description: Brass's new ship built from scavenged parts of her destroyed fleet.

entities.name: Salamander wurm
entities.description: A creature in Ixalan's Core that destroys the Indomitable.

events.summary: Jareth Wake builds enchanted instruments to find Brass, and Lex Briggs crafts six charms to confound him; Swab's trickery lets him find the Scourge.
events.quote: Swab's trickery disrupted Lex's charms just long enough for Jareth to set his course

events.summary: The collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes creates the floating city of High and Dry and leads to the formation of the Brazen Coalition.
events.quote: The literal collision of the Scourge and Squid Eyes led to the creation of the floating city of High and Dry

events.summary: Brass becomes Admiral of the Fathom Fleet.
events.quote: Captain Brass became Admiral Brass, in command of a disciplined, fearsome collection of ships

events.summary: At the outset of the Phyrexian invasion, Brass turns back from an expedition upon seeing Realmbreaker's branches.
events.quote: she turned back when she saw Realmbreaker 's branches arcing over the ocean sky

events.summary: Brass retakes High and Dry from the Phyrexians and becomes its sole leader.
events.quote: she took command of High and Dry as the city's sole leader

events.summary: Facing angry crowds, Brass declares the age of piracy over and the Brazen Coalition a nation.
events.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

events.summary: Brass crashes a Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk meeting and forces support for a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
Brass's ship is destroyed by a salamander wurm in Ixalan's Core, but she escapes with her crew and rebuilds it.
events.quote: she was able to escape with her crew and enough of her ship left to rebuild it

relations.quote: Governor Beckett Brass is a leader of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan
her trusted navigator and first mate, Lex Briggs
Admiral Brass, in command of a disciplined, fearsome collection of ships

relations.note: Hunted her ship to plunder its figurehead.
relations.quote: promising that they could plunder Captain Brass's figurehead
